 IMD Weather Today, November 18, 2026: Cyclone Akvan Threatens the Coast, Winter Fog Covers North India; Check Snowfall and State-Wise Temperature Forecast
 By Aishwarya Samant Last Updated: Nov 18, 2026, 07:18 IST Cyclone Akvan puts India's eastern and southern coasts on alert as winter fog spreads across North India. Check the latest IMD weather forecast for November 18, 2026, including cyclone updates, rainfall warnings, Himalayan snowfall predictions and state-wise temperatures.
 IMD Weather Today, November 18, 2026: Cyclone Akvan Threatens the Coast, Winter Fog Covers North India; Check Snowfall and State-Wise Temperature Forecast 
 IMD Weather Forecast Today: The weather in India is presenting two kinds of skies right now. The contrasting weather across the country on November 18, 2026, indicates that the weather and atmosphere are changing and moving towards peak winter. 
 While Cyclone Akvan is keeping the eastern and southern coasts on high alert, northern states are waking up to chilly mornings and dense fog. 
 The developing depression over the Bay of Bengal is expected to intensify, bringing heavy rainfall, powerful winds and rough sea conditions to coastal regions. 
 On the other hand, Delhi-NCR, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab and Haryana are experiencing a gradual winter chill, with reduced morning visibility. 
 The Himalayan region, however, continues to remain cold and dry, with no significant fresh snowfall expected over the next few days.
